base_setup_commands: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git curl wget apt-transport-https

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: dotnet restore is idempotent; tests run via dotnet test which auto-restores
runtime_profile.notes: Projects target .NET 6.0 (net6.0) and .NET Standard 2.0. .NET SDK 8.0 provides backward compatibility for building and testing these targets.

notes: Base image mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 already includes git and curl, so explicit installation of git and curl in setup_runtime_commands is not required. The .NET SDK 8.0 can build projects targeting .NET 6.0 and .NET Standard 2.0.
